name: Dawnfocal
desc: Housed within Lighthouses, Dawnfocals are priceless lenses utilised by Lightkeepers to focus their Light and Illuminate passages through the [Voidsea](location:voidsea). By illuminating the void between [Luminants](location:luminants), a thin stretch of navigable ocean is brought back into existence and can be traversed by ships. The methods behind their production are a closely-guarded secret.
